_about: Project names quoted from published articles, only where the token's onchain metadata does not give the project's name. Every company's name comes first from its token's onchain metadata (Metaplex). An entry here adds a project name: 'quote' is copied verbatim from the source, 'published' is the article's date, 'read' is the day we read it. The quote must name the token's onchain symbol; the build checks it. Nothing else from the article is used as a fact. Sources are listed in DECISIONS.md and erevna/02-piges.md.
